fields.description: Time zone this business operates in. Used by future integrations (e.g. an Office 365/Outlook calendar sync). Appointments in the form, Calendar and Dispatch Board are shown in the user's time zone (User settings), based on System Settings. Includes daylight saving time (summer time) automatically, like every IANA time zone name.
fields.label: Time Zone

fields.description: Which field to show, alongside the (already correctly local) start/end time, when hovering over a scheduled Site Visit in the Calendar view or the Dispatch Board.
fields.label: Calendar Tooltip Field

fields.description: Hides the mileage/distance fields on Site Visit (Start Address, Customer Site Address, Distance) and the "Calculate Mileage" button, and stops billing mileage automatically. Turn off if this business doesn't bill travel distance.
fields.label: Enable Mileage Calculation

fields.description: Hides the "Remote Visit" checkbox on Site Visit and the e-signature-link workflow. Turn off if every visit is always in-person.
fields.label: Enable Remote Visits

fields.description: Hides the Photos section on Site Visit. Turn off if visits aren't documented with photos.
fields.label: Enable Photos

fields.description: When checked, the Additional Items table is shown on the Site Visit. Uncheck it if this business only bills time and never material/hardware used on-site. Items from the Item Group "Services" can never be added as an Additional Item.
fields.label: Enable Additional Items

fields.description: Free API key from openrouteservice.org, used to calculate the driving distance for a Site Visit.
fields.label: OpenRouteService API Key

fields.description: Free-text address, no Address record required - search-as-you-type via OpenStreetMap. Used as the mileage start point when a Site Visit does not set its own Start Address. Leave empty to use the Company's own default address instead.
fields.label: Default Start Address

fields.description: Item whose Selling Price List rate is billed per kilometer when "Calculate Mileage" adds a line to the Site Visit's Sales Order (round trip by default, see "One-Way Trip Only" on the Site Visit). Leave empty to not bill mileage automatically.
fields.label: Mileage Item

fields.description: What happens for a Site Visit marked as remote: either the signature fields are hidden, or the customer gets an emailed link to sign it themselves.
fields.label: Remote Visit Mode
fields.options:
Hide Signature
Send Signing Link to Customer

fields.description: If set, a Site Visit cannot be submitted without a signature (in-person or, for remote visits in "Send Signing Link" mode, via the emailed link) unless it is a remote visit in "Hide Signature" mode.
fields.label: Signature Required
